product_one_liner.value: Sona is an AI-native workforce management platform that combines scheduling, HR, payroll and communications to help large frontline organisations staff more intelligently and reduce managers’ administrative work.

pricing_page.notes: A substantive pricing page describes configurable pricing and platform features, with a custom quote rather than published numerical rates.

employee_band.notes: Public counts conflict: LeadIQ reports approximately 243 employees in October 2026 and LinkedIn lists 255, supporting this band; Enrich Layer reports 138 as of October 29, 2026.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog index shows workforce insights, partnerships, company news and product announcements, not two engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: The public help centre contains multiple articles covering the app, shifts, messaging, clocking in and other product functions.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A Senior Machine Learning Engineer posting has an application link.

model_provider.notes: Both are explicitly listed as LLM providers.

compliance_certs.notes: These are the requested compliance claims displayed publicly; GDPR is a compliance framework rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced April 1, 2026; led by N47. This was the latest round located.

raised_18mo.notes: The $45 million Series B announced April 1, 2026 falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Account Executive posting has an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: The June 22, 2026 announcement introduced Sona LMS, including AI-powered course creation, within the requested six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Richard Tallboy’s profile lists VP Customer UK / CIO Advisory at Sona starting in January 2026, within the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A revenue-operations posting explicitly identifies these systems as part of Sona’s internal go-to-market stack.
